name: Dacorum Local Plan SA Interim SA Report

housing-numbers.notes: This is an SA report examining growth scenarios rather than the final Local Plan. The LHN figure is 1,018 dpa over 16-year period (2024-2040). Document notes current supply is only 2.19 years, well below required 5-year supply. Various scenarios tested ranging from ~14,000 to ~17,000 homes total.
